srList.sentence: 2.11 Statistical analysis of behavior Data were tested for normality and all comparisons between normally distributed datasets containing two independent groups were performed using unpaired t-tests ( 2-tailed) , data which was found to not follow a normal distribution was compared using non-parametric analyses .
